run_singlepoint_calculations: run singlepoint energy and force calculations on a batch of atomic structures using an ASE calculator
calculate_properties_for_atoms: calculate specified properties like energy and forces for a subset of atomic structures in parallel jobs
write_results_to_json: write singlepoint calculation results as a compressed JSON file to a specified output directory
normalize_properties_by_natoms: normalize calculated properties by number of atoms or a custom key from the atoms info dictionary
save_target_properties: save target properties from atoms info alongside calculated results in the singlepoint output file
